intro: Call of Fire is a sacred rite of passage where an initiate retrieves the Torch of Eternal Flame from an overlook above Loch Modan and carries it to Dun Morogh. Returning the flame to mentor Bruegs Kindleborn proves the traveler's elemental mastery and earns them their Fire Totem.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently.
You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Aye, friend? What do ye have there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: By Madoran's beard, yer spirit burns brighter than any torch I've laid eyes on, friend--and that's somethin' to be proud of.

Keep walkin' this path, and the elements'll bend to yer will. Our kin will come to ye for wisdom and guidance. So let me be the first to offer me hearty congratulations--and present ye with yer newest totem. Ye've earned it, flameborn.
